text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober has been preoccupied<n>with
something ever since the Fan<n>Fest. She manages
to pull herself<n>together right before her race, but...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, she runs into Mejiro<n>Bright and is
nearly crushed by her<n>friend's oppressive aura
and focus.<n>It's clear how determined Mejiro<n>Bright
is to win the spring Tenno Sho.
